units.source_text: 这么一想，我就觉得金周本身也像是一艘渡过时间大海驶来的美丽的部。

en.t: Thinking of it this way, I felt that the Golden Pavilion itself was also like something beautiful that had sailed across the great sea of time.

units.source_text: 美术书上所说的这幢"四周明柱、墙少的建筑物"，使我联想起船的结构，

en.t: This building, described in art books as one with prominent pillars on all sides and few walls, made me think of the structure of a ship,

units.source_text: 这复杂的三层屋形船所面临的池子，给人以海的象征的印象。

en.t: and the pond faced by this complex three-storied houseboat gave the impression of being a symbol of the sea.

units.source_text: 金阁度过了无计其数的茫茫黑夜。

en.t: The Golden Pavilion had passed through countless vast black nights.
This was a voyage without end.

units.source_text: 白昼，这艘奇异的船佯装抛下了锚，让许多游人参观。

en.t: By day, this strange ship pretended to have cast anchor and allowed many visitors to look around.

units.source_text: 天刚擦黑，就借助四周的黑暗，扬起风帆似的屋顶启航了。

en.t: As soon as dusk began to fall, it used the darkness around it to raise its sail-like roof and set out to sea.
